description: This source file defines the `CountryService` class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage and retrieve country and province data through a Data Access Object (DAO). It utilizes traits for normalization and interacts with entity and model classes to handle country-related functionality in the HRM system.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to access and manipulate country and province data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCountryDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the `CountryDao` instance used for database operations related to countries and provinces.

methods.name: setCountryDao
methods.description: Sets the `CountryDao` instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all countries from the DAO.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all provinces from the DAO.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Fetches a country entity based on the country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a country entity based on the country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Fetches a province entity based on the province code.

methods.name: getCountryArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of country models suitable for API or UI consumption.

methods.name: getProvinceArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of province models suitable for API or UI consumption.
